extension.author: Björn Rudner
extension.label: Datamodel: Risk Assessment
extension.description: Adds the ability to document risk parameters on CIs.
extension.version_description: Requires iTop 3.3.0 or later. The five supported CI forms display protection and recovery objectives in the native detail layout. Setup reuses existing audit objects and repairs the original non-repudiation query during upgrades while preserving administrator edits. When System Landscape 3.2.2 or later is selected, an optional bridge adds its read-only field to the application solution portal form.
